title: Intent-Level Quantum Programming with Assertion-Guided Execution and Inspectable Intermediate Representation
summary: Quantum programs are difficult to validate: circuits are typically expressed as imperative gate sequences with limited inspectability, execution modalities must be selected manually, and outputs are inherently probabilistic. These challenges are compounded when programs must be portable across backend frameworks with differing internal conventions.
